footer.desc: Tenrio customer experience skeleton for Microsoft 365 self-service.

home.title: A clear starting point for buying and managing Microsoft 365.
home.desc: This initial skeleton focuses on route structure and presentation only. Pricing, authentication, payment, and subscription state will come from the Backend API in later tasks.
home.point1: App Router pages for public entry points and the initial dashboard.
home.point2: Strict TypeScript configuration and Tailwind-based styling.
home.point3: Static content only, with no backend or payment coupling.
home.card1Desc: The /pricing route introduces Business Basic and Business Standard in plain business language.
home.card2Desc: The /login and /register routes are intentionally UI-only while backend auth is still undefined.
home.card3Desc: The /dashboard route gives us a shell for future orders, subscriptions, billing, and support sections.

pricing.title: Plan presentation starts here, but authoritative pricing stays in the backend.
pricing.desc: This page is intentionally static for the initial skeleton. Final prices, terms, taxes, and availability must be provided by the Backend API.
pricing.plan1Desc: A lightweight setup for business email, collaboration, and cloud productivity.
pricing.plan2Desc: A more complete option for teams that also need desktop productivity software.
pricing.disclaimer: Pricing, billing term, taxes, and final totals will be supplied by trusted backend responses in later tasks.
pricing.card1Desc: Monthly and annual terms are the target MVP options, but availability must follow the chosen Microsoft or distributor offer.
pricing.card2Desc: This skeleton keeps the copy customer-friendly and avoids exposing internal partner terminology.

dashboard.title: A customer dashboard shell for future subscription and billing features.
dashboard.desc: This page is intentionally static in the initial project skeleton. Live customer data, authorization, and status tracking will come from the Backend API later.
dashboard.noDataDesc: This placeholder area will eventually summarize subscriptions, seat counts, payment state, and renewal timing for the signed-in customer.
dashboard.card1Desc: Future work can place order history and payment status here once backend contracts exist.
dashboard.card2Desc: Subscription cards can later show plan, seats, term, and renewal information from trusted backend data.
dashboard.card3Desc: A support entry point can be added here without coupling this task to ticketing or email flows.
